body: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) increasingly demands encoder's capacity for handling a broad range of tasks and modalities with increased complexity. Prior scaling methods either increase the representation size, retrieval effort, or scales the encoder into a heavy multimodal LLM. Recent works, such as Think-Then-Embed (TTE), explore scaling via reasoning tokens. However, embedding models are hard to scale up: increasing parameters directly tradeoffs for the large training batch size that contrastive learning needs, and retrieval has to be served under tight latency. Moreover, UME tasks are diverse in complexity, where scaling up embedders can bring significant redundant computation. In this work, we propose MOEMB, which instead scales UME along the expert axis through mixture-of-experts (MoE), growing encoder capacity while preserving single-vector, non-autoregressive encoding. Through a systematic study of the design space and training recipes for MoE-based UME, MoEMB sets a new state of the art on both MMEB-V2 and MRMR among models trained on public MMEB-family data: with only 3B active parameters, MoEMB surpasses TTE-based methods with >4x active parameters, using significantly less computes. To further improve the scalability and efficiency, we conduct the first comprehensive study of adaptive computation for MoE-based embedding, spanning diverse strategies across training-based and inference-only methods. Together, these results support expert scaling as an effective and efficient direction for UME, with adaptive computation further improving efficiency for MLLM-based embedding models towards large-scale retrieval and recommendation systems.
summaryZh: 该研究提出了MoEMB，一种利用混合专家（MoE）架构来扩展通用多模态嵌入（UME）模型容量的新方法。与传统通过增加表示大小或模型参数来扩展不同，MoEMB沿专家轴扩展，能在保持单向量、非自回归编码的同时，显著提升模型处理复杂多模态任务的能力。通过对MoE设计空间和训练策略的系统研究，MoEMB在MMEB-V2和MRMR基准测试中达到了新的SOTA水平，且仅用3B激活参数就超越了参数量大得多的方法。此外，研究还首次全面探讨了MoE嵌入模型的自适应计算策略，进一步提高了效率，使其适用于大规模检索和推荐系统。

glossary.explanationZh: 能够将不同模态（如文本、图像、音频）的信息映射到统一向量空间的嵌入表示。
一种模型架构，其中包含多个“专家”子网络，根据输入动态选择部分专家进行计算，以提高效率和容量。
一种自监督学习方法，通过拉近相似样本对的表示并推开不相似样本对的表示来学习嵌入。
指模型在生成序列时，不依赖于先前生成元素的输出，可以并行生成。
根据输入或任务的复杂性动态调整计算量的方法。
